retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist 1980s composition featuring an instant photo frame floating over a double-exposed landscape of sand dunes and a gloved hand.
triggerTerms: retro slab serif and script pairing
excludeWhen: naturalistic lighting without airbrushed effects is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex layered composition where a white-bordered instant photograph of a man with curly hair is the central focus, superimposed over a background of deep blue sky, wispy clouds, and red-toned sand dunes that blend into a giant white-gloved hand.
coreVisualRelationships: The instant photo frame acts as a window into a secondary, brighter environment.
The red sand dunes provide a rhythmic, textured base for the lower half of the image.
The white gloved hand creates a surreal scale shift against the landscape.
The top-left slab serif text balances the bottom-right diagonal script.
coreInvariants: Double exposure effect between landscape and hand
High-contrast lighting on the portrait subject
Diagonal baseline for the script typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The portrait is centered within a tilted instant photo frame occupying the middle 60% of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white frame of the instant photo serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left block text, moves down to the central portrait, and follows the diagonal script across the bottom dunes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep indigo sky in the upper corners provides breathing room for the header text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal and bright white (portrait background and frame)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the dunes and portrait, contrasted against the dark, desaturated sky.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and casual cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Header: Uniform stroke weight with thick, blocky rectangular serifs.
Footer: Thin, monolinear script with a consistent upward diagonal slant.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script features an elongated underline that originates from the final letter of the first word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mechanical slab serif for authority paired with a personal, airy script for a 'signed' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, low-contrast slab serif structure of the header.
Captures the informal, slanted handwriting style of the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal landscape with a deep indigo sky and red-orange sand dunes. Overlay a large white-gloved hand that blends into the dunes using a double exposure effect. Place a tilted white-bordered instant photo frame in the center containing a portrait of a man with 80s curly hair against a teal background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase slab serif text in the top-left corner. Add a light, slanted cursive script across the bottom third, tilted upwards at a 15-degree angle with a long underline stroke.

verificationChecks: Is the instant photo frame tilted?
Does the script text have a long underline?
Are the sand dunes a vibrant terracotta red?
Is the header text a heavy slab serif?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the instant photo frame
mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing brand logos
Ensure the hand is generic and not a specific trademarked character glove
postGenerationChecks: Check for the double exposure effect on the hand and dunes.
Verify the slab serif is heavy and blocky.
Ensure the script text is legible despite the slant.
Confirm the teal portrait background contrasts with the indigo sky.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surreal Landscape] + [Double Exposed Hand] + [Floating Instant Photo] + [Slab Serif Header] + [Slanted Script Footer] with [80s Airbrush Finish].
